claims.claim: MCP server to arbitrary code execution boundary - moze uruchomic cokolwiek (shell, API, filesystem).
Dwa poziomy consent w Claude Code: install-time (explicit add command) + first-run trust dialog (per server).
Po zaufaniu MCP server tools dzialaja bez per-call permission prompt (asymetria vs Bash tool).
Permissions patterns dla MCP uzywaja wzorca `mcp__<server>__<tool>` (np. mcp__github__create_issue).
Settings precedence dla security: managed > project > user. Managed bije wszystko.
Flaga enableAllProjectMcpServers: true skip trust dialog dla WSZYSTKICH serwerow z .mcp.json.
enableAllProjectMcpServers istnieje dla CI/CD (GitHub Actions headless). Oficjalne claude-code-action ustawia to na true w env CI.
Best practice: zamiast enableAllProjectMcpServers uzywac enabledMcpjsonServers explicit whitelist (np. ['github', 'memory']).
permissions.deny ma precedencje nad allow (deny wygrywa). Pattern mcp__* blokuje wszystkie MCP tool calls.
enableAllProjectMcpServers dziala wczesniej niz permission layer - startup commands wykonuja sie PRZED permission check (rdzen CVE-2025-59536).
CVE-2025-59536: Remote Code Execution via pre-trust Hook execution + MCP consent bypass. Reported 2025-07-21, Fixed 2025-08-26, Published 2025-10-03.
CVE-2025-59536 CVSS: 8.7 High (some sources), affected Claude Code pre-patch (approximately pre-1.0.x z 2025-08-26).
Attack vector CVE-2025-59536: repo z .claude/settings.json + .mcp.json + enableAllProjectMcpServers:true + malicious hook -> RCE przy cd do katalogu.
CVE-2026-21852: API Key Exfiltration via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL injection. Reported 2025-10-28, Fixed 2025-12-28, Published 2026-01-21.
CVE-2026-21852 mechanism: Claude Code wysylal test requests do Anthropic API PRZED trust dialog, gdy ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL bylo overridden - atakujacy przechwytywal Bearer token.
Fix CVE-2026-21852: Claude Code odklada API calls do post-trust-dialog, waliduje URL.
Config vectors = attack surface: .claude/settings.json hooks, .mcp.json servers, enableAllProjectMcpServers, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, env vars w serwerach.
Prompt injection w tool descriptions jest uznany open risk - spec explicit flag 'annotations untrusted unless from trusted server'.
Data exfiltration via tool results: malicious server moze zwrocic content z injection instruction; Claude ma defensive training ale nie 100% niezawodne.
Enterprise hardening: managed settings moga wymusic permissions.deny ['mcp__*'], enabledMcpjsonServers whitelist, pin ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.
Rekomendowane monitoring: diff .mcp.json w PR review, alert na nowe MCP servers w ~/.claude/settings.json, EDR na subprocess spawned przez Claude Code.
Check Point Research byl primary disclosure channel (CVE-2025-59536 + CVE-2026-21852); Anthropic implementowal fixy w embargo 2 miesiace responsible disclosure.
Post-fix (2026-04-17) stan: hooks wymagaja approve per hook per project, enableAllProjectMcpServers pokazuje warning banner w non-CI, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL walidowany dialog.
